sources.entry: Focused Work: Focus Timer - A simple, flexible Focus Timer. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/focused-work-focus-timer/id1523968394?uo=4&platform=mac)

summary.name: Focused Work
summary.one_liner: Focused Work is a focus and Pomodoro timer app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro that can block distracting apps and websites while a session runs.
use_cases: run pomodoro work and break intervals
block distracting apps and websites during work
track daily focus goals and streaks
keep track of a session from a widget or Live Activity
focus through a busy day with timed sessions
sync productivity stats across Apple devices
summary.what_it_does: Focused Work lets you follow the Pomodoro or Flowmodoro method or build your own timed session structure. It can automatically block apps and websites while the timer is running. You can set daily focus goals and keep a streak going. The current session can be seen from Widgets, Live Activities, and other apps. Productivity stats are saved with iCloud across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro.
notable: Pomodoro and Flowmodoro session structures plus custom timers
Blocks apps and websites automatically while the timer runs
Syncs productivity stats via iCloud across Apple devices
Listed in awesome-mac under To-Do Lists
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page does not mention Windows, Android or Linux support
